reason: lineage_root fails only for epoch 0 or an oversized HKDF output; the epoch is the constant 1 and the output is 32 bytes.
anchor.verify() runs first and refuses epoch 0, so lineage_root cannot fail for a verified anchor.
A checkpoint accepted by encode_checkpoint seals to at most MAX_CHECKPOINT_BYTES - 5 bytes, so the size check never fails.
The true arm of the sealed-size comparison cannot occur after encode_checkpoint accepted the plaintext.
